digest.component_or_area: LLM usage-log and summarize cost accounting
propositions: usage_log.record() must accept optional model and provider parameters and stamp a UTC ISO timestamp internally, propagating these fields to stored rows.
The runner call site must pass the model name and inferred provider to record() so pricing can be calculated downstream.
The summarize command must calculate per-row estimated costs using genai_prices when available, grouping results by operator and model with a cost rollup table.
Pricing failures (unknown models, LookupError, or other exceptions) must be caught and logged without breaking summarize, with unpriced rows annotated and a summary count reported.
When genai_prices is not installed, summarize must degrade gracefully, printing token totals with an 'unavailable' cost message and exiting successfully.
Old-format usage-log rows lacking the new fields must continue to summarize without error for backward compatibility.
